source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, there were 882 stockholders of record of our Class A common stock.

notes: NBIM: its holdings data file at June 30, 2026 has no Snap Inc row: the id it carried at year-end 2024 (2rp9jrmii6fi) is absent, and a name search finds only Snap-on Inc, a different company. So no NBIM holding is recorded for this date. CalPERS: its Form 13F information table for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no Snap shares (searched by issuer name; the only match is Snap-on Inc). Holders of record: Class A only.
